Elemental Resonance[]

Elemental Resonance redirects here. For other uses, see Resonance.
Current Party Elemental Types
When you have a full party, you will receive Elemental Resonance effects that correspond to the Elemental Types present in the party.

Effects[]

Elemental Resonance effects depend on the elements of the first four party members, apply in Co-Op Mode, and do not require all party members to be alive.

Except for Protective Canopy, each Resonance requires two or more characters of the same element among the first four party slots. Having more than two characters of the same element does not further enhance the corresponding Resonance.

In Co-Op Mode, if part of the party is inside a Domain, the resonance will only be determined by the characters that are in the Domain, and only characters in the Domain will benefit from the bonuses.

Name Element Effects
Fervent Flames Affected by Cryo for 40% less time. Increases ATK by 25%.
Soothing Water Affected by Pyro for 40% less time. Increases Max HP by 25%.
High Voltage Affected by Hydro for 40% less time. Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Quicken, Aggravate, or Hyperbloom have a 100% chance to generate an Electro Elemental Particle (CD: 5s).
Shattering Ice Affected by Electro for 40% less time. Increases CRIT Rate against enemies that are Frozen or affected by Cryo by 15%.
Impetuous Winds Decreases Stamina Consumption by 15%. Increases Movement SPD by 10%. Shortens Skill CD by 5%.
Enduring Rock Increases shield strength by 15%. Additionally, when characters protected by a shield or when Moondrifts formed by Lunar-Crystallize reactions are nearby, the following special characteristics will take effect: DMG dealt increased by 15%, dealing DMG to enemies will decrease their Geo RES by 20% for 15s.
Sprawling Greenery Elemental Mastery increased by 50. After triggering Burning, Quicken, Bloom, or Lunar-Bloom reactions, all nearby party members gain 30 Elemental Mastery for 6s. After triggering Aggravate, Spread, Hyperbloom, or Burgeon reactions, all nearby party members gain 20 Elemental Mastery for 6s. The durations of the aforementioned effects will be counted independently.
Protective Canopy Any 4 Unique Elements All Elemental RES +15%, Physical RES +15%.

Moonsign[]

Moonsign
When Moonsign characters are in the party, the party will attain a Moonsign Level corresponding to the number of such characters.
When the party reaches "Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam," Moonsign characters will be enhanced. Non-Moonsign characters can also provide buffs to the party.

Effects[]

Name Moonsign characters Effects
Nascent Gleam 1 All characters in the party will gain the "Moonsign: Nascent Gleam" effect.
Ascendant Gleam 2 All characters in the party will gain the "Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam" effect, enhancing certain Talents and Skills of Moonsign characters. Unless otherwise stated, when Moonsign Level reaches Ascendant Gleam, the effects of Nascent Gleam will also apply.
In addition, for 20s after a non-Moonsign character casts an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they will increase the Lunar Reaction DMG dealt by all nearby characters based on their own Elemental Type, up to a maximum of 36%. This effect cannot stack.
If the character's Elemental Type is:
  • Pyro, Electro, or Cryo: Increases this DMG by 0.9% for every 100 ATK.
  • Hydro: Increases this DMG by 0.6% for every 1,000 Max HP.
  • Geo: Increases this DMG by 1% for every 100 DEF.
  • Anemo or Dendro: Increases this DMG by 2.25% for every 100 Elemental Mastery.

Ascendant Gleam Buff Thresholds[]

Character stats required to reach maximum Ascendant Gleam Lunar Reaction DMG buff:

  • Pyro, Electro, or Cryo: 4,000 ATK
  • Hydro: 60,000 Max HP
  • Geo: 3,600 DEF
  • Anemo or Dendro: 1,600 Elemental Mastery

Region-Based Effects[]

The following effects are affected by each character's associated region in the party. Unlike Elemental Resonance, Moonsign, and Hexerei, these effects are not listed on the Party Setup menu.

Nightsoul Burst[]

Main article: Nightsoul's Blessing § Nightsoul Burst

When there is at least one Natlanese character in the party, a Nightsoul Burst can be triggered at set intervals. For every Natlanese characters in the party, the interval between Nightsoul Bursts will decrease: 18 seconds for 1 character, 12 seconds for 2 characters, and 9 seconds for 3 or more characters. Characters like Bennett or a Pyro-aligned Traveler do not count toward enabling Nightsoul Burst or decreasing its cooldown, even if they are canonically from Natlan or are able to enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state, respectively.
